parameters.name: Enable
parameters.description: Enables/disables this user object instance. If the User being configured is currently accessing the device then a disable MUST apply to the next user session and the current user session MUST NOT be abruptly terminated.

parameters.name: UserID
parameters.description: Unique Identifier of the user. Depending on the implementation this can be the unique identifier assigned by the underlying system.

parameters.name: RemoteAccessCapable
parameters.description: Allows this user to remotely access the UserInterface via the mechanism defined in {{object|##.UserInterface.HTTPAccess}} {{deprecated|2.16|due to the introduction of {{object|.UserInterface.HTTPAccess.{i}.}} and {{param|RoleParticipation}}}} {{obsoleted|2.18}} {{deleted|2.19}}

parameters.name: Username
parameters.description: Name of the current user. MUST NOT be {{empty}} for an enabled entry.

parameters.name: GroupParticipation
parameters.description: The Groups of which this User is a member.

parameters.name: RoleParticipation
parameters.description: The Roles which are assigned to this User.

parameters.name: StaticUser
parameters.description: A static user is a fixed user that is always available in the system. When set to {{true}}, the user cannot be removed.

parameters.name: Language
parameters.description: String describing the default language for the local configuration interface, specified according to {{bibref|RFC3066}}. If {{empty}}, {{param|##.UserInterface.CurrentLanguage}} is used.

object.description: This object contains parameters relating to the user characteristics.
